knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the price must cover labour including set-up and travel, materials, protective equipment, waste, licences and a share of overheads. Product only (option 0) and the hour on site only (option 2) leave out costs the lesson requires.

The lesson says a discount must be checked against the full cost and any approval recorded with its reason, and safety controls are not discounted away. Giving the discount regardless (option 0) and cutting safety controls (option 2) are ruled out.
The count the full cost section says to count labour time, including set-up, travel, the site induction, the handover and the administration.

practicalCriteria: Learner builds a pricing worksheet for a supplied job with labour, travel, materials, protective equipment, waste and overhead shares.
Learner checks a supplied discount against the full cost and records the approval and reason, or declines it.
Learner includes the time for safety controls, such as a walk-through, in the supplied price.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Pricing worksheet for each quote with cost components and method
Record of any discount or below-cost price, with approval and reason
stopWorkCriteria: Learner issues a quote for licensed work the business does not hold a licence for
Learner removes safety controls to meet a price
